summary: Iteration 7 testing: trust score, streak, bonus ladder, tier-based withdrawal. Backend 51/51 pytest pass (18 NEW iter7 tests + 33 regression). Frontend: found CRITICAL P0 bug — Dashboard.jsx was missing imports for `nextBonusMilestone` and `ProgressionStrip`, causing the entire /app/dashboard page to crash with 'nextBonusMilestone is not defined' uncaught runtime error. Testing agent applied the missing-import fix (single-line scope) and verified all 3 ProgressionStrip cards now render correctly (Trust 52/100 Building tier · 24h hold · Max $25/24h, Streak 0 days, Next Milestone $2 at task #10). Withdrawal trust info card renders correctly with tier label + delay + cap copy.

minor.issue: Spec mentions /refresh should return trust_score/current_streak/longest_streak but the implementation returns only {message, access_token, token_type}. /login, /register, /me DO return them correctly. Low priority since /refresh is for renewing tokens, not for fetching user state — frontend can call /me after refresh.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Missing imports caused full page crash: `nextBonusMilestone` (used in getNextBonus) and `ProgressionStrip` (rendered as <ProgressionStrip />) were never imported. Added: `import ProgressionStrip from '../components/ProgressionStrip';` and `import { nextBonusMilestone } from '../config/economics';`. After fix, dashboard renders cleanly with 0 console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: PRECISE BONUS MATH VERIFIED: After 10 fresh tasks → exactly $4.00 ($1×10 task + $1@5 + $2@10). Task #5 reward_earned=1.10, task #10 reward_earned=2.10. bonuses_earned_count returns 2 at task #10. next_bonus_milestone after 10 → {25, $5}. All exact.

STREAK MULTIPLIER APPLIES CORRECTLY: At streak=3, 0.10×1.1 = $0.11. At streak=7, 0.10×1.25 = $0.125. At streak=14 with task #5 hit, reward = 0.10×1.5 + 1.00 = $1.15 (multiplier on base only, NOT on milestone bonus — confirmed).
STREAK GAP RESETS: 3-day gap with last_active_date=3 days ago resets current_streak to 1, preserves longest_streak (5). Same-day repeats keep streak unchanged.
TRUST: +1 per task verified. +5 bonus on crossing into 7-day streak (50→56 confirmed: 1 task = +1 base + 5 streak crossing). +2 on successful withdrawal verified (50→52 after $5 withdraw).

TIER GATING: building tier (trust=50) → status='pending', message contains '24h hold'. Daily cap enforced: $20 + $10 attempt → 400 with 'limit'/'$25' error. trusted tier (trust=80) → status='approved', max_daily=$100, delay=0h.
LEDGER: withdrawal_requests document includes trust_tier_at_request, delay_hours, estimated_payout_at — good for audit trail.

FRONTEND DASHBOARD HAD MISSING IMPORTS: This is a serious oversight — both ProgressionStrip and nextBonusMilestone were used in JSX but not imported. The error message 'nextBonusMilestone is not defined' surfaced via the dev runtime overlay, but in production builds this would crash the page silently. Suggest enabling ESLint with no-undef rule pre-commit.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE of Dashboard crash: When iteration 7 was implemented, the agent added `<ProgressionStrip />` JSX into Dashboard.jsx and refactored getNextBonus() to call nextBonusMilestone(), but FORGOT to add the corresponding `import` statements for both symbols. The bug only surfaces at runtime (no static error in `yarn build` because React component trees are evaluated at render time). REPRO: log in as admin → navigate to /app/dashboard → React error overlay shows 'ReferenceError: nextBonusMilestone is not defined at getNextBonus (Dashboard.jsx)'. MITIGATION: Added `import ProgressionStrip from '../components/ProgressionStrip';` and `import { nextBonusMilestone } from '../config/economics';` at the top of Dashboard.jsx. Re-tested: 0 console errors, all 3 progression cards render with live API data.
